notes: «عن رجل، لم يسمه» is an unnamed link at its place in the order (rule 8)
Tirmidhi's «وقد روى بعضهم» names a different route for the same saying without the unnamed man: a variant group, never a route
«رواه أبو أسامة وغير واحد» gives further narrators of that variant; no chain is written for them, so no group is read
«وصالح بن كيسان لم يدرك عقبة بن عامر» is a grading remark, left out
